gv_QUERY_SBCS.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT  SBCS_AU.HIST_ROW_ID,SBCS_AU.HIST_CREATE_DTM,SBCS_AU.SBSB_CK,SBCS_AU.SBCS_EFF_DT,SBCS_AU.SBCS_TERM_DT,SBCS_AU.GRGR_CK,SBCS_AU.CSCS_ID,SBCS_AU.SBCS_LOCK_TOKEN,SBCS_AU.ATXR_SOURCE_ID,SBCS_AU.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM ,SBCS_AU.SYS_USUS_ID,SBCS_AU.SYS_DBUSER_ID FROM AGP.BOSS_FIS_INVOICE AGP_BOSS   INNER JOIN FACETS_AU.CMC_SBCS_CLASS SBCS_AU   ON AGP_BOSS.SBSB_CK = SBCS_AU.SBSB_CK WHERE    SBCS_AU.HIST_ROW_ID = (SELECT MAX(SBCS_AU1.HIST_ROW_ID) FROM FACETS_AU.CMC_SBCS_CLASS SBCS_AU1                       WHERE SBCS_AU1.SBSB_CK = AGP_BOSS.SBSB_CK AND                       (EXTRACT( YEAR FROM AGP_BOSS.BLBL_DUE_DT) BETWEEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SBCS_AU1.SBCS_EFF_DT) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SBCS_AU1.SBCS_TERM_DT)) AND                       SBCS_AU1.HIST_CREATE_DTM <= AGP_BOSS.BLBH_CREATE_DTM    AND SBCS_AU1.HIST_IMAGE_CD = 'A'   AND SBCS_AU1.CSCS_ID LIKE 'CH%'                  )'

gv_QUERY_PDPD_AU.value: ' SELECT   DISTINCT T.PDPD_ID, T.PDPD_EFF_DT, T.PDPD_TERM_DT,  T.LOBD_ID FROM (   SELECT      PDPD_AU.PDPD_ID, PDPD_AU.PDPD_EFF_DT, PDPD_AU.PDPD_TERM_DT,  PDPD_AU.LOBD_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PDPD_AU.PDPD_ID ORDER BY PDPD_AU.HIST_ROW_ID DESC) AS RANK   FROM      AGP.FINT_FIS_PDPD AGP_BOSS     INNER JOIN FACETS_AU.CMC_PDPD_PRODUCT PDPD_AU         ON AGP_BOSS.PDPD_ID = PDPD_AU.PDPD_ID AND AGP_BOSS.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN PDPD_AU.PDPD_EFF_DT AND PDPD_AU.PDPD_TERM_DT                WHERE      PDPD_AU.HIST_CREATE_DTM <= AGP_BOSS.BLBH_CREATE_DTM ) T  WHERE T.RANK = 1  '

BOSS_FIS   ON INDI.BLIV_ID = BOSS_FIS.BLIV_ID  WHERE BOSS_FIS.BLEI_CK NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT BLEI_CK FROM CTE_BLEI_CK)   UNION   SELECT DISTINCT  INDI.BLIV_ID,INDI.BLDI_SEQ_NO,INDI.BLDI_PRINT_SEQ,INDI.BLDI_DISP_CD,INDI.BLDI_PREM_FEE_IND,INDI.BLDI_DESC,INDI.PMFA_ID,INDI.PMFA_DESC,INDI.BLDI_FEE_DISC_AMT,INDI.CSPI_ID ,INDI.PLDS_DESC,INDI.PDPD_ID, INDI.PDBL_ID,INDI.BLDI_LVS_SB,INDI.BLDI_LVS_DEP,INDI.BLDI_VOL,INDI.BLDI_PREM_SB, INDI.BLDI_PREM_DEP,INDI.MCRE_CRCR_ID,INDI.MCRE_NAME,INDI.USUS_ID,INDI.USUS_DESC ,MR.SBSB_CK AS SBSB_CK_FIS,BOSS_FIS.GRGR_CK AS GRGR_CK_FIS,BOSS_FIS.SGSG_CK AS SGSG_CK_FIS,BOSS_FIS.BGBG_CK AS BGBG_CK_FIS FROM FACETS.CDS_INDI_DISCRETN INDI INNER JOIN AGP.BOSS_FIS_INVOICE BOSS_FIS gv_QUERY_PDPD_AU.defaultValue:

  DISTINCT T.PDPD_ID, T.PDPD_EFF_DT, T.PDPD_TERM_DT,  T.LOBD_ID
FROM
(
  SELECT 
    PDPD_AU.PDPD_ID, PDPD_AU.PDPD_EFF_DT, PDPD_AU.PDPD_TERM_DT,  PDPD_AU.LOBD_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PDPD_AU.PDPD_ID ORDER BY PDPD_AU.HIST_ROW_ID DESC) AS RANK
  FROM 
    AGP.FINT_FIS_PDPD AGP_BOSS
    INNER JOIN FACETS_AU.CMC_PDPD_PRODUCT PDPD_AU

  WHERE 
    PDPD_AU.HIST_CREATE_DTM <= AGP_BOSS.BLBH_CREATE_DTM
) T
 WHERE
T.RANK = 1'
